entities.summary: Nusa Penida is an island located near the southeastern Indonesian island of Bali, which forms a district of the same name in Klungkung Regency. The Badung Strait separates the island and Bali. The interior of Nusa Penida is hilly with a maximum altitude of 524 metres, and the climate is drier than Bali. Like Bali, it is a major tourist destination. Nusapenida Island is a island in Southeast Asia. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
